{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the cleaning
print(f"First 5 cleaned revenue values: {df['revenue_clean'].head().tolist()}")
print(f"Revenue dtype after cleaning: {df['revenue_clean'].dtype}")"}
